prompts:
Use case: logo-brand / typography asset. Create a production typography SPRITE SHEET for a PlayStation game's English chapter cards. This is ONE reusable lettering asset, NOT an illustration or words. Portrait canvas exactly in a 3:4 aspect ratio. Strict perfectly regular invisible grid of SIX columns and EIGHT rows, all 48 cells identical size, no gutters outside this grid. In every occupied cell put ONE white glyph centered horizontally and vertically. Exact cell contents read left to right by row:
Row 1: A B C D E F
Row 2: G H I J K L
Row 3: M N O P Q R
Row 4: S T U V W X
Row 5: Y Z 0 1 2 3
Row 6: 4 5 6 7 8 9
Row 7: ! ? ' , . -
Row 8: : ( ) [empty cell] [empty cell] [empty cell]
Important: row 7 third cell is a SINGLE APOSTROPHE. Row 7 fourth is a COMMA. The final three cells are completely empty, do NOT print the words empty cell or brackets. Every glyph stays safely within its cell with large consistent clear margins; use the same cap height for all letters and digits. All glyphs are from one polished unified clean BOLD CONDENSED UPRIGHT sans-serif display typeface suitable for cinematic chapter titles: subtle squared humanist geometry, legible true I versus numeral 1, rounded O versus numeral 0, consistent weight, smooth simple contours, no stencil cuts. Flat solid white letter fill with smooth antialiased edges. Actual transparent background, no grid lines, no rules, no labels, no borders, no textures, no gradients, no shadows, no effects, no ornaments, no scenery. Letters must remain legible at just 20 native pixels high. Preserve exact ordering and do not duplicate or omit any glyph.

Edit this typography sprite sheet. Replace ALL the noisy speckled backdrop and every stray mark with perfectly uniform solid BLACK (#000000). Retain ONLY the 45 intended white glyphs, in exactly the same six-column eight-row positions and ordering, including the final three empty cells. Make the actual glyph faces solid pure white with clean smooth antialiased contours; remove the dirty outlines and stray black scratches inside the glyph faces. No texture, no grunge, no particles, no new marks, no grid, no cell borders, no effects. Uniform opaque black everywhere except the intended simple clean white lettering. Keep the exact letter shapes, cap heights, grid layout and original portrait canvas crop. This is a clean font sprite sheet, NOT artwork. Every glyph must be disconnected from every other glyph and from the canvas edges by clear black margins.
assets.notes: The first noisy transparent variant was rejected. Use the clean opaque-black sprite sheet only. Its 45 glyphs were visually checked in grid order.

assets.prompt: Use case: text-localization / cinematic intertitle asset for a PlayStation game. Create ONE clean English narration line, exact text and capitalization: 'And nearly twelve years had passed...' Do not include quotation marks. Exactly three periods at the end. One single uninterrupted horizontal line, centered, comfortable letter spacing and balanced word spacing, perfectly level baseline. Use polished clean medium-weight humanist sans-serif lettering with natural lowercase, plain solid white fill, smooth antialiased edges, no pixel-font styling. Quiet cinematic narration, not a sports logo and not italic. A very wide horizontal canvas, with generous black margins around all sides. Background must be perfectly uniform opaque pure black (#000000), with no transparency, texture, speckles, gradients, glow, shadows, rules, icons, logos, scenery or additional text. The line must remain legible when baked into a 300-pixel-wide native game image. Keep all letters intact, no clipping, no ornate letters or serif flourishes.
assets.text: And nearly twelve years had passed...

implementation: Native raster sprite encoding; the title wording and changing stage-number logic are preserved.
